The eye is dark with a round pupil. The background is blurred (bokeh), suggesting a shallow depth of field.

The transition between the lower jaw and the coiled body beneath it is slightly ambiguous and soft, lacking clear anatomical separation, though not catastrophic.
The catchlight in the eye is generic and doesn't clearly reflect a coherent environment, common in AI generations, but minor.
